Hi Denise — thanks for the clear note and the PO attachment.

Short answers up front: yes on both (portal push + email copies for 60 days) and yes we can include your PO and tax id on the invoice header. We do have two implementation choices depending on how you want to validate receipts:

Option A — Portal-first (recommended):
- Redwood sends e-invoice XML to your Aria endpoint (we support UBL/XML and a minimal JSON e-invoice payload).
- Simultaneously we send a PDF copy to ap-team@acme-corp.com for human reconciliation for 60 days; after that we can stop the email copies.
- Billing contact in our console: set to finance@acme-corp.com (we send transactional notifications); add ap-team@acme-corp.com as notification-only.

Option B — Email-primary with portal archive:
- We email PDF invoices to ap-team@acme-corp.com by default and push a copy to your portal for archival.
- This is easier if your AP team cannot accept XML webhook immediately.

Operational notes:
- We will include PO GF3321 and your tax id (EIN: 12-3456789) in the invoice header and PDF footer.
- We need a signed MSA alias/scan to store in the account (attached to this thread for records).
- For the portal push we need a test endpoint and a sample auth token; we can accept Basic Auth or a short-lived HMAC token.

I'll loop Marissa for the ticket to Eng/Onboarding to wire the portal push and Laura for billing configuration in the console. If you’re good with Option A, reply OK and we’ll start the 60-day email-copy window the day of the first portal push.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
